function.name: check_appointment_availability
function.description: Check real roofing inspection availability in Google Calendar before offering any appointment times. Offer only returned ISO timestamps and state times in the configured local time zone.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book one of the exact available ISO timestamps returned by check_appointment_availability. The server checks Google Calendar again and creates a real event. Say the appointment is confirmed only if the result has booked=true, status=confirmed, and mode=live. If mode=mock, say this is a demonstration and no real booking was made.

requestedStart.description: Exact ISO-8601 UTC slot returned by availability.

phone.description: Caller callback phone in E.164 format.

function.name: prepare_human_transfer
function.description: Record the caller's request to speak with a person. After the result, use the separately configured Vapi Transfer Call tool only after the caller agrees.
